segments.comment: A flying hero on a seen Castle trap door presses '>'. do.c dodown() finds uescaped_shaft() true for any seen hole or trap door under the hero (do.c:1225-1228) and calls dotrap(trap, TOOKPLUNGE); trap.c fall_through() prints "You swoop down through the trap door!" and sends the hero to the Valley through find_hell(). The later goto_hell() arm of dodown() (do.c:1281-1282) therefore never runs; this recording is the evidence. The wished trap door starts unseen, and a flying hero passes over it without finding it, so wizard-mode ^F (wizcmds.c wiz_map()) marks it seen. Seed, clock, character and keys were chosen for this path.
